messages.subject: Part 5 for 24 hour data
parts:
Dear Vincent, 

I am interested in using GGIR to calculate objective physical activity data (inactivity, light, moderate, vigorous). However, we only have files with 24-hour data. Is it possible to use GGIR part 5 for such an analysis? 

Best regards, 
Tint

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 5 for 24 hour data
parts:
Dear Tint,

At the moment I think this is not possible.
If your recordings start at day time outside the typical sleep windows (e.g. in the afternoon) then this may be possible to develop. Although, it would take time and by that funding. If you see any opportunities to attract funding for such development then let me know.

Best regards,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
